name: Whirlwind Bracelet
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

A whirlwind bracer is a thin golden bracelet inscribed with lightning bolts and storm clouds. It is small enough to be easily hidden beneath loose clothes or heavy gloves. As a standard action you can reach toward the sky and be transformed into a violent and crackling whirlwind for one round. When transformed you are made of air, granting you DR 10/magic and a flight speed of 100 feet (perfect). You may pass through squares occupied by creatures and objects but cannot pass through walls or other immovable solid objects, though you may be able to pass through particularly drafty windows, and openings in solid objects.

Whenever you pass through a square occupied by a creature, that creature must make a reflex save with a DC of 15 or take 3d8 electricity damage. The bracelet can be activated three times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, polymorph
